summary: 71 cells, 709.4304 um2. Setup WNS 4.090087 (tt), 1.569947 (ss, worst) and 5.078808 (ff) ns; hold WNS 0.279601, 0.817408 and 0.077297 ns. The worst paths start at the up_down input, go through a fanout-13 nor3b gate (1.084077 ns), then the carry logic, and end at counter flip-flops.
assumptions: Constraints in constraints.sdc (10 ns clock, 0.25 ns uncertainty, 3.0 ns I/O delays, all DEFAULT) were used unchanged; I did not edit them.
The numbers in reports/synth_tool.json are the real OpenLane 2 / OpenSTA results for the netlist named there.
WNS per corner is taken as the worst slack value reported per corner; TNS was not provided.
open_issues: Equivalence check (eqy) results and cell class breakdown were not supplied, so no equivalence claim is made.
Net _014_ has fanout 13 while the SDC sets max fanout 10; confirm in the flow's max-fanout report whether this is flagged.
Only 3 of the worst 10 paths are in the input and the third is cut off before its slack line; the full path report is needed to describe the rest.
PDK release and corners are not pinned in the spec (open question in spec.yaml).

self_assessment.reason: All numbers are quoted from the tool data, but the path report is truncated, there is no TNS, no eqy data and no cell class breakdown.
